recipe: Create a single pre-configured API client instance (using fetch, axios, graphql-request, or apollo-client) and reuse it throughout your application instead of instantiating multiple clients.

evidence: it is beneficial to use a single instance of the API client that has been pre-configured and can be reused throughout the application

recipe: Define and export API requests in separate modules rather than declaring them inline on the fly, so all endpoint declarations are colocated and easy to track.
trigger_condition: You are making API calls in your React application and want to keep endpoint declarations organized and discoverable.
evidence: Rather than declaring API requests on the fly, it is recommended to define and export them separately.
